Tirunelveli campus connect
 Updated - November 16, 2026 06:36 pm IST 
 The Hindu Bureau Subscribe to The Hindu @ Just ₹1* Subscribe to The Hindu @ Just $4.99 *Offer only for new subscribers EPFO Foundation Day
 Advertisement Advertisement The Department of Management Studies in association with the Department of Master of Computer Applications of St. Xavier’s Catholic College of Engineering, Chunkankadai, organised a seminar-cum-celebration of the 74th Foundation day of the Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO).
 Addressing the gathering, P. Subramani, Regional Provident Fund Commissioner-II (RPFC-II), highlighted the significance of EPFO in ensuring the financial security of employees through provident fund savings, pension benefits and employees’ deposit linked insurance.
 Jitender Meena, Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC), shared insights into various initiatives and recent developments of EPFO. He emphasised the Indian government’s effort to strengthen social security coverage, simplify provident fund services and enhance transparency through digital transformation.

 The session created awareness among students of the importance of provident fund contribution, pension planning, employee welfare and role of statutory social security institutions in the Indian economy.
 As part of the celebrations college students were honoured for its association with the programme and five students who won a quiz competition were recognised and felicitated.
